nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point. POST from NestJS with the envelope {runId, ownerId, jobId, agentId, payload}. Checks the X-Agora-Secret header and answers 200 at once; the work continues in the background.

nodes.name: Read envelope
nodes.notes: Takes the request body and flattens envelope + payload into one item, so later nodes can read $('Read envelope').first().json.jobId and friends. Stops if runId is missing.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Reads the bid window (minutes) and the NEAR AI Cloud model id.

parameters.query:
SELECT b.id, b.price, b.status::text AS status, b.price_check::text AS price_check,
       b.fraud_score, b.reference_median, b.note,
       extract(epoch FROM b.delivery_eta) / 86400 AS eta_days,
       s.display_name, s.kind::text AS kind,
       coalesce(r.settled_jobs, 0) AS settled_jobs, r.first_try_pass_rate,
       (SELECT coalesce(max(n.round), 0) FROM negotiation_messages n WHERE n.bid_id = b.id) AS rounds,
       (SELECT n.sender FROM negotiation_messages n WHERE n.bid_id = b.id
         ORDER BY n.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_sender,
       j.posted_at, j.title, j.description
FROM bids b
JOIN jobs j ON j.id = b.job_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.id = b.seller_id
LEFT JOIN reputation r ON r.account_id = s.near_account_id
WHERE b.job_id = $1::uuid AND b.status IN ('live', 'shortlisted');

nodes.name: Load bids
nodes.notes: Live and shortlisted bids with seller reputation, risk, rounds so far and the job text.

nodes.name: Wait rule and shortlist
nodes.notes: Code decides: wait until 3 offers or the window ends; drop held and flagged bids; score the rest and keep the top 5. Needs payload.maxPrice.

nodes.name: Wait?
nodes.notes: True: log 'waiting' and stop. False: shortlist and ask the model.

nodes.name: Mark shortlisted
nodes.notes: Sets status shortlisted on the chosen bids.

nodes.name: Build prompt
nodes.notes: Shortlist (seller notes untrusted), the hidden maximum and the typical price. Runs on NEAR AI Cloud so the limit stays private from the provider.

nodes.name: Ask LLM
nodes.notes: Calls the lib llm-json sub-workflow: one model call that must return a JSON object with the required keys, or the run fails.

nodes.name: Guard decision
nodes.notes: Code decides: never accept or offer above maxPrice, max 3 rounds, unknown bid ids fall back to the top of the shortlist.

nodes.name: Counter?
nodes.notes: True: save the counter-offer. False: accept or no deal.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO negotiation_messages
  (job_id, bid_id, round, sender, sender_agent_id, body, offered_price, attestation)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::smallint, 'buyer_agent', $4::uuid, $5, $6::numeric, $7)
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Save counter
nodes.notes: Inserts negotiation_messages (sender buyer_agent) with the attestation hash.

nodes.name: Finish
nodes.notes: Builds one item with the feed message for agent_events and the 'notify' body for NestJS. Messages are written for the owner to read.

nodes.name: Log event
nodes.notes: Calls lib log-event: inserts the row into agent_events (the live activity feed).

nodes.name: Notify Nest
nodes.notes: Calls lib notify-nest: POST /agents/notify so NestJS moves the job to its next step. Errors are ignored, so the agent still works while Nest is not built.
